answer.text: Clients on-boarded without a distributor; only statutory charges levied

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Direct option allows client to skip distributor; only statutory charges apply. **The Trap:** KYC remains mandatory; channel does not alter it. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same concept in MF Direct Plans (V-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Prominently disclose Direct option on website, DD and marketing collaterals.
